stem: Priya lists four things she notices on her way to school in Pune. Her teacher says that matter is anything that has mass and takes up space. Which one of the following is matter?

options.text: The sunlight falling on the road
The heat from a roadside tea stall
The air inside a cycle tyre
The light from a street lamp

teacher.key_rationale: Air has mass and occupies space (it inflates the tyre), so it is matter. Sunlight, heat and lamplight are forms of energy with no mass and do not take up space, so they are not matter.
